description: Erection of an additional storey and glass ridge rooflight. Glass balustrades to the attic storey. Amendments to the fenestration to upgrade the existing windows to double glazing, and replace two existing sash windows with three pairs of french doors. Electric vehicle lift to extend the excavated garden to provide concealed parking for electric vehicles, bikes and tool area. New layer of insulation and additional wall thickness to the existing wall to provide insulation with an external London stock brick slips. Replacement of the front garden wall with brick wall. Replacement garden wall, including a wider vehicle gate and pedestrian gate. Move forward the existing porch.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Condition : 5 - The windows to be fitted on the roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the use of the heat pump, the enclosure of the heat pump hereby permitted shall be installed. The level of noise emitted from the heat pump shall be at least 10dB below the background noise levels at all times near to the noise sensitive receptors.
Condition : 7 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 8 - No excavation or construction works on the basement hereby permitted shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.

Condition : 9 - No excavation or construction works on the basement hereby permitted shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the local planning authority of a Construction Logistics Plan which will include delivery timings, suspension of bays and temporary licence if material storage is required on the public highway. The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the details so approved.
Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the Flood Risk Assessment prepared by Innervision Design Ltd dated July 2022.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the Construction Method Statement prepared by Noble Structures Ltd dated September 2023, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.
